summary.prose: The build adds a test-side compiler scanner that lists the module-scope state a session worker loads, and a small pure guard that compares that list with a reviewed inventory file. Most of the effort is the classification itself: reading each of a few hundred declarations and recording whether a per-thread copy is right, it lives in a shared store, or one thread must own it. Once the inventory is complete the guard runs over the whole repo, and the values that turn out to need a single owner are brought to you to decide, case by case, whether to move them here or track them separately.

tasks.title: Module-state scanner over the session worker's import closure
tasks.summary: Add moduleStateInventory as a test-side module in src/daemon/threads/__tests__/ following connection-source-inventory's ts.Program approach: walk value imports (static and string-literal dynamic) from src/daemon/threads/session-worker.ts within src/, excluding __tests__ and *.test.ts, and report top-level lets/vars, non-frozen constructed instances, and const array/object literals that are not frozen and that the checker finds written. Deterministic order by key. Unit test over a temp project.
acceptanceChecks: Reports let/var, constructed containers and written const literals; skips read-only and `as const`/Object.freeze literals
Follows static and dynamic imports; skips modules outside the entry's closure and type-only imports
Throws when the tsconfig cannot be read
Same input gives the same sorted output

tests.name: module-state-inventory.test.ts: the scanner reports lets, constructed containers and written const literals, skips read-only and frozen tables, follows dynamic imports and skips modules outside the closure (temp project)
module-state-inventory.test.ts: the scanner throws on an unreadable tsconfig and is deterministic

tasks.title: Guard logic: compare sites with the fixture and validate entries
tasks.summary: A pure function over (sites, fixture, routed method sets) that returns the problems: keys missing from the fixture, stale fixture keys, an invalid class, a one-owner entry with no owner, a reason under 40 characters, and a one-owner entry owned by the shared-state worker whose named method prefix no member of SHARED_STATE_METHODS or IN_DAEMON_SHARED_METHODS starts with. It can be limited to a key prefix so a classification slice can be checked alone.
acceptanceChecks: Each kind of problem is reported, naming the key and what is wrong, on altered inputs
A clean input reports nothing
A prefix limit checks only keys under that prefix

tests.name: module-state-inventory.test.ts: the guard names a missing key, a stale key, an invalid class, a missing owner, a short reason and an unrouted shared-state owner, and reports nothing on a clean input

tasks.title: Classify the src/daemon entries
tasks.summary: Run the scanner over the repo and write fixture entries (class, owner for one-owner, reason of at least 40 characters) for every site under src/daemon/, reading each declaration and its uses. The four s3 families are classified as s3 made them. Every entry that needs a single copy but does not have one is listed as a move candidate in the build record. A test checks the src/daemon/ slice with the guard logic.
acceptanceChecks: The guard logic limited to src/daemon/ reports no problem over the real repo
The four s3 families carry the s3 mechanism as their reason
Move candidates are listed with the reason a single copy is needed

tests.name: module-state-inventory.test.ts: every scanned key under src/daemon/ has a valid fixture entry, and the s3 families are one-owner on the shared-state worker or shared-store

tasks.title: Classify every scanned key outside src/daemon and turn on the full guard
tasks.summary: Write fixture entries for every scanned key not under src/daemon/, with the same rules, extending the move-candidate list; then add the full guard test over the real repo (no prefix limit), which from here on fails on any new, stale or invalid entry.
acceptanceChecks: The full guard test passes over the real repo
The fixture's keys equal the scanner's keys exactly
Move candidates outside src/daemon are listed

tests.name: module-state-inventory.test.ts: every module-scope mutable value the session worker can load is classified (full guard over the repo)

tasks.title: Move-candidate review with the user
tasks.summary: Present the complete move-candidate list (each value that needs a single copy but lacks one, with its reason and the likely mechanism) to the user, who decides per candidate: move inline in this Story, or raise as a separate tracked item. Record the decisions in the build record; file a tracked item for each one raised separately.
acceptanceChecks: Every move candidate has a recorded user decision
Each candidate raised separately has a tracked item filed
If there are no candidates, that is recorded with the evidence

tests.name: module-state-inventory.test.ts: every one-owner or shared-store entry names the mechanism that gives it one copy (no unresolved candidate is left in the fixture)

tasks.title: Inline moves
tasks.summary: For each candidate the user chose to move inline: route its method family to the owner (extending SHARED_STATE_METHODS/inDaemonTarget as s3 did) or keep the value in an existing cross-thread store; update its fixture entry; add a two-session-worker test that both workers reach the one owner. Skipped with a recorded reason if t5 chose none.
acceptanceChecks: Each inline move has a two-session-worker test proving one owner
method-class tests and the guard pass
No inline move was made without a t5 decision

tests.name: method-class.test.ts and a two-session-worker test per moved family: both workers reach the one owner (or, with no inline moves, method-class.test.ts still passes)

tasks.title: Refresh the session-source inventory for edited production files
tasks.summary: If t6 edited production files the session-source inventory pins, refresh their entries with the refresh tool and run that test; otherwise record that no production file changed.
acceptanceChecks: The session-source inventory entries for every production file this Story edited are refreshed, or the record states none were edited

tests.name: session-source-inventory.test.ts: the entries for files this Story edited match (or no production file was edited)
